summary: Source-reviewed rework closed the prior activity/database/adjudication blockers for RapTB. The final record supports RapTB as a human lung HBB(112-147) peptide with extracellular anti-Mtb activity, low macrophage toxicity at the tested concentration, cell-envelope disruption morphology, and no intracellular Mtb efficacy; APD6 linkage/PMID conflicts are retained as cautions.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF, extracted OA package figures, supplementary landing assets, and packet/merged APD6 rows were opened. Supplementary landing assets are HTML/figure surfaces and did not provide additional structured tables beyond the XML captions and OA images.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6 AP05999 literature identity is source-verified against DOI/PMID/PMCID and primary sequence, while AP05999 experiment-row PMID mismatch and AP05958 anoplin linkage are preserved as source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 now records source-supported RapTB activity/toxicity rows from XML/PDF/figures: 53% extracellular Mtb inhibition at 50 uM, 13% macrophage cytotoxicity at 50 uM, >79% lower-dose macrophage viability, and negative intracellular Mtb efficacy.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 adjudication preserves direct SEM cell-envelope disruption evidence and separates it from negative localization/intracellular efficacy findings without promoting a molecular target.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_review: Prior source-review completion ticket is closed because the relevant XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database paths were opened and owner-layer artifacts were repaired.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 AP05999 experiment row carries raw PMID 30176261, while article XML and packet literature canonical metadata give PMID 41209728 for DOI 10.3389/fmicb.2025.1669022.
APD6 AP05958 is an Ano-5K/anoplin record for DOI 10.1002/psc.598 and is not a RapTB row from this paper.
Primary-source CFU/MGIA results indicate RapTB did not reduce intracellular Mtb under tested conditions.

closed_rework_tickets.resolution: Activity rows, database conflict adjudication, and worker-6 source-reviewed final closeout were repaired from local materials.
